canonicalSections.heading: What Counts as Structure
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 必须区分：

```
PARAMETER
```

与：

```
STRUCTURE
```

---

## A. Parameter

在不改变系统基本组织方式的情况下调整。

例如：

```
working hours
meeting count
budget amount
schedule
task allocation
communication frequency
```

---

## B. Structure

决定系统基本运行关系的 arrangement。

例如：

```
employment model
ownership model
income model
location model
care arrangement
relationship arrangement
organizational hierarchy
debt structure
business model
role definition
```

---

## C. Why the distinction matters

例如：

```
Current structure:
full-time fixed-location employment
```

参数调整可能是：

```
start 1 hour later
work from home 1 day/week
reduce one project
```

结构替代可能是：

```
hybrid role
part-time role
contract work
different employer
portfolio work
self-employment
```

NAV-17 不允许把任何小变化都夸成 structural change。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Core Structural States
canonicalSections.body:
建议 runtime 至少区分：

```
PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED
MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
```

---

## A. `PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED`

现实仍显示：

```
local adjustment
can materially improve fit
```

此时没有必要提前把结构性改变推到前面。

---

## B. `STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED`

虽然存在不满或摩擦，但：

```
current structure still responsive
lower-level responses not exhausted
material threshold not reached
```

---

## C. `STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED`

已有足够现实依据让至少一个不同结构进入正式比较。

不是推荐，只是：

```
comparison eligibility granted
```

---

## D. `MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED`

可能存在多个结构候选。

例如：

```
stay but reduce scope
internal transfer
different employer
portfolio career
self-employment
```

不得自动压成：

```
stay vs quit
```

---

## E. `STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED`

当前结构已经与现实发生足够大失配，应正式重新检查结构本身。

但仍未决定替代方案。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `allowedInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 可以：

## A. 识别局部调整反复失败

例如：

```
reduce meetings
change schedule
delegate tasks
```

都已尝试，但核心：

```
availability expectation
role scope
authority mismatch
```

仍不变。

可以判断：

```
PARAMETER_REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT
```

---

## B. 识别新增投入已无法改善结构失配

直接读取 NAV-16：

```
RETURN_DIMINISHING
RETURN_FLAT
NEGATIVE_RETURN
```

作为结构候选 admission evidence。

---

## C. 识别真正问题属于结构而非参数

例如：

```
“我需要更少会议”
```

如果根源是：

```
job requires permanent cross-time-zone coordination
```

那么会议数量可能只是表面参数。

---

## D. 识别存在另一种结构但尚未成熟

例如：

```
part-time model
```

概念上可行，但需要：

```
employer agreement
income recalculation
care coordination
```

可以标记：

```
CONDITIONALLY_ADMITTED_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE
```

---

## E. 识别结构改变可以分阶段发生

例如：

```
full-time employment
→ reduced scope
→ hybrid
→ contract
```

不是只有：

```
stay
vs
leave
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `forbiddenInference`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 严禁：

## A. 把困难直接解释成结构问题

```
hard
≠
structural mismatch
```

---

## B. 把所有局部调整失败解释成必须重构

有时问题是：

```
execution quality
temporary shock
wrong adjustment
insufficient time
```

---

## C. 用 symbolic reading 宣布结构必须改变

禁止：

```
BaZi says transformation
→ career structure must change
```

---

## D. 把“新结构存在”当成“新结构更好”

```
alternative exists
≠
alternative qualified
```

---

## E. 把改变形式包装成进步

```
new
≠
better
```

---

## F. 用用户厌倦自动推断 structural mismatch

厌倦可以触发 inquiry，但不是结构证据。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 主要影响：

```
OPTION_SPACE_EXPANSION
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION
OPTION_COMPARISON_REQUIREMENT
ACTION_SCALE
DECISION_THRESHOLD
```

核心 effect：

```
REMOVE_STRUCTURE_MONOPOLY
```

即：

> **原结构不再自动拥有唯一的解决权。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `decisionThresholdEffect`
canonicalSections.body:
结构性替代通常：

```
higher impact
lower reversibility
more affected parties
larger transition cost
```

因此：

```
admission threshold
```

和：

```
execution threshold
```

必须分开。

冻结：

```
LOWER THRESHOLD:
allow alternative to be compared

HIGHER THRESHOLD:
actually execute structural change
```

这是 NAV-17 很重要的边界。

> **让一个方案进入比较，不应该和真正执行它使用同样高的门槛。**

否则系统会因为改变成本高，而连替代方案都不允许被看见。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `authorityBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 可以：

- 区分 parameter / structure；
- 识别局部修正是否仍有效；
- 允许结构性替代进入候选；
- 建立多个结构候选；
- 识别 transition requirements；
- 要求后续更高 threshold。

NAV-17 不可以：

- 自动选择新结构；
- 自动执行结构改变；
- 因现结构不完美而取消它；
- 使用 Method Reading 建立结构现实；
- 把 novelty 当价值。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `humanDecisionBoundary`
canonicalSections.body:
系统可以判断：

```
structural alternative deserves comparison
```

但用户仍然决定：

```
whether changing structure is worth the disruption
```

例如系统可以说：

> 目前已经有足够理由让“内部调岗”和“不同雇主”进入比较。

不能直接说：

> 你应该换工作。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `sourceSections`
canonicalSections.body:
主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.19｜修正参数，还是把重构放进候选
```

相关：

```
15.13｜还在运行，究竟能证明什么
15.14｜维持成本什么时候改变决定
15.15｜原方向什么时候失去默认资格
15.16｜问题扩散以后，优先级为什么会改变
15.17｜容量什么时候成为硬约束
15.18｜什么时候更多投入已经不再合理
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `relatedBookFoundations`
canonicalSections.body:
## Book VI｜Reality Reconfiguration

Book VI 拥有：

```
structure
reconfiguration
carrier change
constraint rearrangement
```

NAV-17 不重新解释现实如何重组。

它只决定：

> **什么时候结构性替代应该进入下一步决策空间。**

这是非常重要的 owner boundary：

```
Book VI:
How structures reconfigure

NAV-17:
When structural reconfiguration deserves decision consideration
```

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

Book III 提供：

```
maintenance
failure compensation
continuity strain
```

帮助 NAV-17 判断局部维护是否仍足够。

---

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
evidence
uncertainty
causal boundary
```

防止系统因为表面失效就过度归因于结构。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `profileConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Profile 可以帮助理解：

```
environment fit
role preference
autonomy preference
friction pattern
```

但不能直接建立：

```
CURRENT_STRUCTURE_MISMATCH
```

必须由现实支持。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `financialConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Financial 对结构候选非常重要。

例如：

```
employment structure change
```

需要比较：

```
income model
liquidity
insurance
debt
fixed commitments
transition runway
```

因此一个结构可能 conceptually attractive，却因财务条件：

```
NOT_YET_EXECUTABLE
```

但仍可以：

```
ADMITTED_FOR_COMPARISON
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `methodConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR：

只能：

```
raise interpretive questions
```

例如：

```
是否当前角色结构长期制造某种重复摩擦？
```

但必须回到现实验证。

不得：

```
declare restructuring necessary
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `currentRealityConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
currentStructure
adjustmentsTried
persistentConstraints
whatDidNotChange
whatImproved
whatStillCostsMore
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `runtimeConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-17 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Organizational Navigation
Professional Handoff
Report Follow-up
```

消费。

尤其需要支持：

```
same domain
different structure
```

而不是只支持：

```
same structure
different parameter
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `academyConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Academy 可投影为：

> **Not every hard problem requires a new structure; but some problems remain hard precisely because the structure itself has stopped responding to adjustment.**

中文：

> **不是所有困难都需要换结构，但有些问题之所以反复存在，正是因为原结构已经不再对局部调整产生足够回应。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `revisionTriggers`
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况必须重开 NAV-17：

```
localAdjustmentSucceeds
localAdjustmentFails
newAlternativeAppears
capacityChanges
maintenanceCostChanges
returnPatternChanges
contractChanges
authorityChanges
financialRunwayChanges
affectedPartyChanges
professionalInput
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Structural Alternative Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "structuralReviewId": "",
  "currentStructure": "",
  "parameterAdjustmentsTried": [],
  "persistentStructuralConstraints": [],
  "admissionState": "PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED | STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED | STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED | MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED | STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED | STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT",
  "alternatives": [],
  "transitionRequirements": [],
  "transitionCosts": [],
  "reversibilityEffects": [],
  "capacityRequirements": [],
  "affectedParties": [],
  "unknowns": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Parameter-vs-Structure Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

> **A parameter changes how the current structure operates; a structural alternative changes the arrangement through which the system operates.**

中文：

> **参数调整改变的是现有结构怎样运行；结构性替代改变的是系统通过什么样的安排来运行。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Repair Sufficiency Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果现实仍然对：

```
lower-cost
lower-impact
more reversible adjustments
```

产生明显回应，则这些路径必须保持可见。

系统不能因为“结构改变更彻底”就提高其权重。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structural Admission Rule
canonicalSections.body:
至少出现以下一种情况时，可以支持结构候选 admission：

```
persistent structural constraint
repeated local adjustment failure
maintenance cost materially rising
capacity repeatedly saturated
diminishing / flat / negative marginal return
cross-domain propagation persists
current structure no longer serves core value
```

但没有任何单项必须自动触发。

应综合判断。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Admission vs Execution Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

> **The threshold for allowing a structural alternative to be considered is lower than the threshold for actually executing structural change.**

中文：

> **让结构性替代进入比较所需要的门槛，应低于真正执行结构性改变的门槛。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Transition Cost Rule
canonicalSections.body:
任何结构性替代必须显式记录：

```
transition cost
```

例如：

```
income gap
learning curve
relationship disruption
moving cost
legal cost
operational downtime
identity adjustment
```

否则 Navigation 会对新结构产生不公平偏好。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Alternative Structure Must Also Be Tested
canonicalSections.body:
不能因为原结构出现问题，就把新结构理想化。

每个 alternative 仍需进入：

```
NAV-02 Current Position
NAV-04 Time
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-07 Time Horizon
NAV-15 Capacity
```

的相关检查。

新结构不能绕过现实。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structural Alternative Classes
canonicalSections.body:
可以扩展：

```
ROLE_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
INCOME_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
LOCATION_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
RELATIONSHIP_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
CARE_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
OWNERSHIP_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
ORGANIZATIONAL_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
FINANCIAL_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
```

避免所有 structural change 都被理解成：

```
leave / quit / end
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Partial Structural Change Rule
canonicalSections.body:
有些结构改变可以是部分的。

例如：

```
full-time → 4-day week
single-income → mixed-income
office-only → hybrid
centralized care → shared care
single supplier → diversified supplier
```

这类方案可能比完全退出具有更高可逆性。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structural Continuity Rule
canonicalSections.body:
新结构不一定意味着放弃旧结构中的全部价值。

可以问：

```
what should be carried forward?
```

这直接为 NAV-19 Value Preservation 做准备。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structure Lock-In Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果现结构存在：

```
high switching cost
legal lock-in
debt lock-in
relationship dependency
institutional dependency
```

应标记：

```
STRUCTURAL_LOCK_IN
```

但：

```
lock-in
≠
permanent impossibility
```

它只是提高 transition burden。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structural Fantasy Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果替代结构仅存在于愿望层：

```
“I'll just start a business”
“I'll just move overseas”
“I'll just freelance”
```

但没有：

```
capacity
pathway
conditions
```

则只能：

```
CONCEPTUAL_ALTERNATIVE
```

不能视为成熟候选。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Structural Evidence Rule
canonicalSections.body:
新结构取得候选资格至少需要：

```
problem it addresses
conditions it changes
requirements it creates
costs it introduces
what remains unknown
```

不能只因为：

```
sounds better
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Current Structure May Requalify
canonicalSections.body:
即使结构性替代已经进入比较，原结构仍可能通过：

```
new authority
new resources
role redesign
cost reduction
capacity restoration
```

重新取得资格。

因此：

```
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMITTED
```

不意味着：

```
CURRENT_STRUCTURE_REJECTED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Current Structure:
Full-time role with fixed scope and permanent availability expectation

Adjustments Tried:
schedule change
meeting reduction
delegation

Result:
hours remain high
authority unchanged
maintenance cost rising
return flat

State:
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在值得进入比较的，已经不只是“怎样把现有工作再调好一点”。**
> 
> 你已经尝试过调整排程、减少会议和重新分工，但真正没有改变的是岗位本身对持续在线、职责范围和权限关系的要求；与此同时，为了维持同样结果，你投入的时间继续增加，新增投入带来的改善却越来越有限。
> 
> 这还不足以推出“应该离职”，但已经足以让另一种工作结构正式进入候选，例如内部角色转换、不同雇主、缩小工作范围，或其他收入结构。接下来需要比较的，是这些结构分别保护什么、要求什么，又会带来哪些新的代价。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Keep parameter adjustment
Admit structural alternative
Add alternative
Reject alternative
Compare structures
Define transition requirement
Reassess current structure
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_QUALIFIED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMITTED
MULTIPLE_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-18：

```
currentStructureUndefined
parameterAndStructureConflated
localAdjustmentHistoryFabricated
alternativeInventedWithoutFeasibilityBasis
symbolicReadingUsedAsStructuralAuthority
transitionCostIgnored
affectedPartyIgnored
capacityStateMissing
marginalReturnStateMissing
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must allow structural alternatives to enter comparison when the current structure repeatedly fails to respond to proportionate adjustment, additional input, or restored capacity.**

中文：

> **当现有结构反复无法对合理的局部调整、追加投入或容量恢复产生足够回应时，Navigation 必须允许结构性替代进入正式比较。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Non-Automation Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Admitting a structural alternative does not mean choosing it.**

中文：

> **允许一种结构性替代进入候选，并不等于已经选择它。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Proportionality Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Structural change should not be granted default priority merely because it is more comprehensive than parameter adjustment.**

中文：

> **结构性改变不能仅仅因为“更彻底”，就比参数调整自动取得更高优先权。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Transition Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Every structural alternative must carry its own transition cost, capacity requirement, reversibility profile, and unknowns into comparison.**

中文：

> **每一种结构性替代都必须带着自己的转换成本、容量要求、可逆性与未知进入比较，而不能只展示它理想的一面。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Continuity Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Changing structure does not require abandoning every value contained in the old structure; what deserves preservation must be identified separately.**

中文：

> **改变结构并不意味着必须放弃旧结构中的全部价值；哪些东西值得被保留下来，必须另外判断。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-17
STRUCTURAL ALTERNATIVE
```

**Input**

```
Current Structure
+
Adjustment History
+
Maintenance Cost
+
Capacity State
+
Marginal Return
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
Is the problem still a parameter problem?
Have proportionate adjustments worked?
Is more input still productive?
Which structural constraints persist?
Should another arrangement enter comparison?
```

**Output**

```
Structural Alternative Admission State
```

**Boundary**

```
Alternative admitted does not mean alternative chosen.
Current structure questioned does not mean current structure failed.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-17｜Structural Alternative

## 结构性替代｜什么时候不该再继续修参数，而应该让另一种结构进入候选

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **当局部调整与追加投入都越来越难改善现实以后，什么时候“换一种结构”才真正取得候选资格？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-17
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
结构性替代
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Structural Alternative
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
当局部调整与追加投入都越来越难改善现实以后，
什么时候“换一种结构”才真正取得候选资格？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Structural Alternative** 是 Navigation 对“当前结构是否已经不值得只继续做参数修正，而应正式允许另一种组织方式、关系方式、工作方式、资源配置方式或生活结构进入比较”进行判断的机制。

它不等于：

```
RESTRUCTURE_NOW
```

也不等于：

```
CURRENT_STRUCTURE_FAILED
```

更不是：

```
NEW_STRUCTURE_IS_BETTER
```

它真正回答的是：

> **什么时候现实已经提供足够理由，让另一种结构从‘想象中的可能’升级成‘应该被认真比较的候选’？**

例如，当前工作问题最初可能只是：

```
meeting load too high
```

可以通过：

```
schedule adjustment
meeting reduction
delegation
```

处理。

但如果经过多轮局部调整以后，真正不变的仍然是：

```
role requires permanent availability
authority remains low
workload remains structurally high
income depends on this arrangement
```

那么问题可能已经不是：

> 怎样把这个岗位调得更舒服？

而是：

> **这个岗位结构本身，是否还应该继续垄断候选空间？**

因此：

> **NAV-17 不负责宣布必须重构，而是决定“另一种结构是否已经有资格进入正式比较”。**

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

很多现实问题会长期停留在：

```
adjust parameter
add resource
try harder
monitor longer
```

因为结构性改变通常：

- 成本更高；
- 风险更大；
- 更不可逆；
- 会影响更多人；
- 会打破既有秩序。

因此，保守地先做局部调整通常是合理的。

但如果 Navigation 永远只允许：

```
PARAMETER_REPAIR
```

它也会形成另一种偏差：

> **无论现实怎样变化，都假设原结构必须保留。**

NAV-17 因此建立：

```
Current Structure
↓
Local Adjustment History
↓
Maintenance Cost
↓
Capacity Constraint
↓
Diminishing Return
↓
Structural Alternative Admission
```

关键 distinction：

```
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMITTED
≠
STRUCTURAL_CHANGE_CHOSEN
```

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-17 最低需要：

```
currentStructure
currentDecisionObject
currentPosition
currentResponseLevel
localAdjustmentHistory
continuationQualificationState
maintenanceCostState
capacityQualificationState
marginalReturnState
```

如果系统不知道：

```
what counts as the current structure
```

则不得进入结构比较。

应标记：

```
STRUCTURE_UNDEFINED
```

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
relationshipContext
careerContext
organizationalContext
professionalInput
timeHorizonMap
reversibilityProfile
crossDomainPropagationMap
priorNavigationState
externalCurrentEvidence
```

这些用于判断：

- 结构到底是什么；
- 哪些部分只是参数；
- 哪些部分已经属于结构；
- 改变结构会影响谁；
- 是否存在更小的结构替代。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

允许：

```
USER_REPORTED
DIRECTLY_OBSERVED
VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_DATA
FINANCIAL_RECORD
CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
ORGANIZATIONAL_RECORD
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
CURRENT_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE
PROFILE_EVIDENCE
REPORT_INTERPRETATION
SYMBOLIC_READING
PRIOR_NAVIGATION_STATE
```

但结构存在与结构约束必须主要来自：

```
OBSERVED_STRUCTURE
VERIFIED_CONSTRAINT
MATERIAL_DEPENDENCY
ROLE_OR_CONTRACT_STRUCTURE
```

不能仅凭解释系统说：

```
you need transformation
```

就建立结构改变资格。

---

# 10. What Counts as Structure

NAV-17 必须区分：

```
PARAMETER
```

与：

```
STRUCTURE
```

---

## A. Parameter

在不改变系统基本组织方式的情况下调整。

例如：

```
working hours
meeting count
budget amount
schedule
task allocation
communication frequency
```

---

## B. Structure

决定系统基本运行关系的 arrangement。

例如：

```
employment model
ownership model
income model
location model
care arrangement
relationship arrangement
organizational hierarchy
debt structure
business model
role definition
```

---

## C. Why the distinction matters

例如：

```
Current structure:
full-time fixed-location employment
```

参数调整可能是：

```
start 1 hour later
work from home 1 day/week
reduce one project
```

结构替代可能是：

```
hybrid role
part-time role
contract work
different employer
portfolio work
self-employment
```

NAV-17 不允许把任何小变化都夸成 structural change。

---

# 11. Core Structural States

建议 runtime 至少区分：

```
PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED
MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
```

---

## A. `PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED`

现实仍显示：

```
local adjustment
can materially improve fit
```

此时没有必要提前把结构性改变推到前面。

---

## B. `STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED`

虽然存在不满或摩擦，但：

```
current structure still responsive
lower-level responses not exhausted
material threshold not reached
```

---

## C. `STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED`

已有足够现实依据让至少一个不同结构进入正式比较。

不是推荐，只是：

```
comparison eligibility granted
```

---

## D. `MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED`

可能存在多个结构候选。

例如：

```
stay but reduce scope
internal transfer
different employer
portfolio career
self-employment
```

不得自动压成：

```
stay vs quit
```

---

## E. `STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED`

当前结构已经与现实发生足够大失配，应正式重新检查结构本身。

但仍未决定替代方案。

---

# 12. `allowedInference`

NAV-17 可以：

## A. 识别局部调整反复失败

例如：

```
reduce meetings
change schedule
delegate tasks
```

都已尝试，但核心：

```
availability expectation
role scope
authority mismatch
```

仍不变。

可以判断：

```
PARAMETER_REPAIR_INSUFFICIENT
```

---

## B. 识别新增投入已无法改善结构失配

直接读取 NAV-16：

```
RETURN_DIMINISHING
RETURN_FLAT
NEGATIVE_RETURN
```

作为结构候选 admission evidence。

---

## C. 识别真正问题属于结构而非参数

例如：

```
“我需要更少会议”
```

如果根源是：

```
job requires permanent cross-time-zone coordination
```

那么会议数量可能只是表面参数。

---

## D. 识别存在另一种结构但尚未成熟

例如：

```
part-time model
```

概念上可行，但需要：

```
employer agreement
income recalculation
care coordination
```

可以标记：

```
CONDITIONALLY_ADMITTED_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE
```

---

## E. 识别结构改变可以分阶段发生

例如：

```
full-time employment
→ reduced scope
→ hybrid
→ contract
```

不是只有：

```
stay
vs
leave
```

---

# 13. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-17 严禁：

## A. 把困难直接解释成结构问题

```
hard
≠
structural mismatch
```

---

## B. 把所有局部调整失败解释成必须重构

有时问题是：

```
execution quality
temporary shock
wrong adjustment
insufficient time
```

---

## C. 用 symbolic reading 宣布结构必须改变

禁止：

```
BaZi says transformation
→ career structure must change
```

---

## D. 把“新结构存在”当成“新结构更好”

```
alternative exists
≠
alternative qualified
```

---

## E. 把改变形式包装成进步

```
new
≠
better
```

---

## F. 用用户厌倦自动推断 structural mismatch

厌倦可以触发 inquiry，但不是结构证据。

---

# 14. `decisionEffect`

NAV-17 主要影响：

```
OPTION_SPACE_EXPANSION
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION
OPTION_COMPARISON_REQUIREMENT
ACTION_SCALE
DECISION_THRESHOLD
```

核心 effect：

```
REMOVE_STRUCTURE_MONOPOLY
```

即：

> **原结构不再自动拥有唯一的解决权。**

---

# 15. `decisionThresholdEffect`

结构性替代通常：

```
higher impact
lower reversibility
more affected parties
larger transition cost
```

因此：

```
admission threshold
```

和：

```
execution threshold
```

必须分开。

冻结：

```
LOWER THRESHOLD:
allow alternative to be compared

HIGHER THRESHOLD:
actually execute structural change
```

这是 NAV-17 很重要的边界。

> **让一个方案进入比较，不应该和真正执行它使用同样高的门槛。**

否则系统会因为改变成本高，而连替代方案都不允许被看见。

---

# 16. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-17 可以：

- 区分 parameter / structure；
- 识别局部修正是否仍有效；
- 允许结构性替代进入候选；
- 建立多个结构候选；
- 识别 transition requirements；
- 要求后续更高 threshold。

NAV-17 不可以：

- 自动选择新结构；
- 自动执行结构改变；
- 因现结构不完美而取消它；
- 使用 Method Reading 建立结构现实；
- 把 novelty 当价值。

---

# 17. `humanDecisionBoundary`

系统可以判断：

```
structural alternative deserves comparison
```

但用户仍然决定：

```
whether changing structure is worth the disruption
```

例如系统可以说：

> 目前已经有足够理由让“内部调岗”和“不同雇主”进入比较。

不能直接说：

> 你应该换工作。

---

# 18. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.19｜修正参数，还是把重构放进候选
```

相关：

```
15.13｜还在运行，究竟能证明什么
15.14｜维持成本什么时候改变决定
15.15｜原方向什么时候失去默认资格
15.16｜问题扩散以后，优先级为什么会改变
15.17｜容量什么时候成为硬约束
15.18｜什么时候更多投入已经不再合理
```

---

# 19. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book VI｜Reality Reconfiguration

Book VI 拥有：

```
structure
reconfiguration
carrier change
constraint rearrangement
```

NAV-17 不重新解释现实如何重组。

它只决定：

> **什么时候结构性替代应该进入下一步决策空间。**

这是非常重要的 owner boundary：

```
Book VI:
How structures reconfigure

NAV-17:
When structural reconfiguration deserves decision consideration
```

---

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

Book III 提供：

```
maintenance
failure compensation
continuity strain
```

帮助 NAV-17 判断局部维护是否仍足够。

---

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
evidence
uncertainty
causal boundary
```

防止系统因为表面失效就过度归因于结构。

---

# 20. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可以帮助理解：

```
environment fit
role preference
autonomy preference
friction pattern
```

但不能直接建立：

```
CURRENT_STRUCTURE_MISMATCH
```

必须由现实支持。

---

# 21. `financialConsumer`

Financial 对结构候选非常重要。

例如：

```
employment structure change
```

需要比较：

```
income model
liquidity
insurance
debt
fixed commitments
transition runway
```

因此一个结构可能 conceptually attractive，却因财务条件：

```
NOT_YET_EXECUTABLE
```

但仍可以：

```
ADMITTED_FOR_COMPARISON
```

---

# 22. `methodConsumer`

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR：

只能：

```
raise interpretive questions
```

例如：

```
是否当前角色结构长期制造某种重复摩擦？
```

但必须回到现实验证。

不得：

```
declare restructuring necessary
```

---

# 23. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
currentStructure
adjustmentsTried
persistentConstraints
whatDidNotChange
whatImproved
whatStillCostsMore
```

---

# 24. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-17 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Organizational Navigation
Professional Handoff
Report Follow-up
```

消费。

尤其需要支持：

```
same domain
different structure
```

而不是只支持：

```
same structure
different parameter
```

---

# 25. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可投影为：

> **Not every hard problem requires a new structure; but some problems remain hard precisely because the structure itself has stopped responding to adjustment.**

中文：

> **不是所有困难都需要换结构，但有些问题之所以反复存在，正是因为原结构已经不再对局部调整产生足够回应。**

---

# 26. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-17：

```
localAdjustmentSucceeds
localAdjustmentFails
newAlternativeAppears
capacityChanges
maintenanceCostChanges
returnPatternChanges
contractChanges
authorityChanges
financialRunwayChanges
affectedPartyChanges
professionalInput
```

---

# 27. Canonical Structural Alternative Model

建议：

```
{
  "structuralReviewId": "",
  "currentStructure": "",
  "parameterAdjustmentsTried": [],
  "persistentStructuralConstraints": [],
  "admissionState": "PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_STILL_QUALIFIED | STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_YET_ADMITTED | STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED | MULTIPLE_STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED | STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED | STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT",
  "alternatives": [],
  "transitionRequirements": [],
  "transitionCosts": [],
  "reversibilityEffects": [],
  "capacityRequirements": [],
  "affectedParties": [],
  "unknowns": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 28. Parameter-vs-Structure Rule

冻结：

> **A parameter changes how the current structure operates; a structural alternative changes the arrangement through which the system operates.**

中文：

> **参数调整改变的是现有结构怎样运行；结构性替代改变的是系统通过什么样的安排来运行。**

---

# 29. Repair Sufficiency Rule

如果现实仍然对：

```
lower-cost
lower-impact
more reversible adjustments
```

产生明显回应，则这些路径必须保持可见。

系统不能因为“结构改变更彻底”就提高其权重。

---

# 30. Structural Admission Rule

至少出现以下一种情况时，可以支持结构候选 admission：

```
persistent structural constraint
repeated local adjustment failure
maintenance cost materially rising
capacity repeatedly saturated
diminishing / flat / negative marginal return
cross-domain propagation persists
current structure no longer serves core value
```

但没有任何单项必须自动触发。

应综合判断。

---

# 31. Admission vs Execution Rule

冻结：

> **The threshold for allowing a structural alternative to be considered is lower than the threshold for actually executing structural change.**

中文：

> **让结构性替代进入比较所需要的门槛，应低于真正执行结构性改变的门槛。**

---

# 32. Transition Cost Rule

任何结构性替代必须显式记录：

```
transition cost
```

例如：

```
income gap
learning curve
relationship disruption
moving cost
legal cost
operational downtime
identity adjustment
```

否则 Navigation 会对新结构产生不公平偏好。

---

# 33. Alternative Structure Must Also Be Tested

不能因为原结构出现问题，就把新结构理想化。

每个 alternative 仍需进入：

```
NAV-02 Current Position
NAV-04 Time
NAV-06 Reversibility
NAV-07 Time Horizon
NAV-15 Capacity
```

的相关检查。

新结构不能绕过现实。

---

# 34. Structural Alternative Classes

可以扩展：

```
ROLE_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
INCOME_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
LOCATION_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
RELATIONSHIP_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
CARE_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
OWNERSHIP_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
ORGANIZATIONAL_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
FINANCIAL_STRUCTURE_ALTERNATIVE
```

避免所有 structural change 都被理解成：

```
leave / quit / end
```

---

# 35. Partial Structural Change Rule

有些结构改变可以是部分的。

例如：

```
full-time → 4-day week
single-income → mixed-income
office-only → hybrid
centralized care → shared care
single supplier → diversified supplier
```

这类方案可能比完全退出具有更高可逆性。

---

# 36. Structural Continuity Rule

新结构不一定意味着放弃旧结构中的全部价值。

可以问：

```
what should be carried forward?
```

这直接为 NAV-19 Value Preservation 做准备。

---

# 37. Structure Lock-In Rule

如果现结构存在：

```
high switching cost
legal lock-in
debt lock-in
relationship dependency
institutional dependency
```

应标记：

```
STRUCTURAL_LOCK_IN
```

但：

```
lock-in
≠
permanent impossibility
```

它只是提高 transition burden。

---

# 38. Structural Fantasy Rule

如果替代结构仅存在于愿望层：

```
“I'll just start a business”
“I'll just move overseas”
“I'll just freelance”
```

但没有：

```
capacity
pathway
conditions
```

则只能：

```
CONCEPTUAL_ALTERNATIVE
```

不能视为成熟候选。

---

# 39. Structural Evidence Rule

新结构取得候选资格至少需要：

```
problem it addresses
conditions it changes
requirements it creates
costs it introduces
what remains unknown
```

不能只因为：

```
sounds better
```

---

# 40. Current Structure May Requalify

即使结构性替代已经进入比较，原结构仍可能通过：

```
new authority
new resources
role redesign
cost reduction
capacity restoration
```

重新取得资格。

因此：

```
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMITTED
```

不意味着：

```
CURRENT_STRUCTURE_REJECTED
```

---

# 41. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Current Structure:
Full-time role with fixed scope and permanent availability expectation

Adjustments Tried:
schedule change
meeting reduction
delegation

Result:
hours remain high
authority unchanged
maintenance cost rising
return flat

State:
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMISSION_SUPPORTED
```

客户可以看到：

> **现在值得进入比较的，已经不只是“怎样把现有工作再调好一点”。**
> 
> 你已经尝试过调整排程、减少会议和重新分工，但真正没有改变的是岗位本身对持续在线、职责范围和权限关系的要求；与此同时，为了维持同样结果，你投入的时间继续增加，新增投入带来的改善却越来越有限。
> 
> 这还不足以推出“应该离职”，但已经足以让另一种工作结构正式进入候选，例如内部角色转换、不同雇主、缩小工作范围，或其他收入结构。接下来需要比较的，是这些结构分别保护什么、要求什么，又会带来哪些新的代价。

---

# 42. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Keep parameter adjustment
Admit structural alternative
Add alternative
Reject alternative
Compare structures
Define transition requirement
Reassess current structure
Continue
```

---

# 43. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
PARAMETER_ADJUSTMENT_QUALIFIED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_NOT_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_ADMITTED
MULTIPLE_ALTERNATIVES_ADMITTED
STRUCTURAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
STRUCTURAL_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
REOPENED
```

---

# 44. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-18：

```
currentStructureUndefined
parameterAndStructureConflated
localAdjustmentHistoryFabricated
alternativeInventedWithoutFeasibilityBasis
symbolicReadingUsedAsStructuralAuthority
transitionCostIgnored
affectedPartyIgnored
capacityStateMissing
marginalReturnStateMissing
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

# 45. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must allow structural alternatives to enter comparison when the current structure repeatedly fails to respond to proportionate adjustment, additional input, or restored capacity.**

中文：

> **当现有结构反复无法对合理的局部调整、追加投入或容量恢复产生足够回应时，Navigation 必须允许结构性替代进入正式比较。**

---

# 46. Canonical Non-Automation Rule

> **Admitting a structural alternative does not mean choosing it.**

中文：

> **允许一种结构性替代进入候选，并不等于已经选择它。**

---

# 47. Canonical Proportionality Rule

> **Structural change should not be granted default priority merely because it is more comprehensive than parameter adjustment.**

中文：

> **结构性改变不能仅仅因为“更彻底”，就比参数调整自动取得更高优先权。**

---

# 48. Canonical Transition Rule

> **Every structural alternative must carry its own transition cost, capacity requirement, reversibility profile, and unknowns into comparison.**

中文：

> **每一种结构性替代都必须带着自己的转换成本、容量要求、可逆性与未知进入比较，而不能只展示它理想的一面。**

---

# 49. Canonical Continuity Rule

> **Changing structure does not require abandoning every value contained in the old structure; what deserves preservation must be identified separately.**

中文：

> **改变结构并不意味着必须放弃旧结构中的全部价值；哪些东西值得被保留下来，必须另外判断。**

---

# 50. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-17
STRUCTURAL ALTERNATIVE
```

**Input**

```
Current Structure
+
Adjustment History
+
Maintenance Cost
+
Capacity State
+
Marginal Return
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
Is the problem still a parameter problem?
Have proportionate adjustments worked?
Is more input still productive?
Which structural constraints persist?
Should another arrangement enter comparison?
```

**Output**

```
Structural Alternative Admission State
```

**Boundary**

```
Alternative admitted does not mean alternative chosen.
Current structure questioned does not mean current structure failed.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
当等待不再只是保留选择，而开始持续消耗现实条件时，
什么时候“再等等”本身就需要被重新证明？
modules.definition:
**Waiting Cost** 是 Navigation 对“延迟决定或延迟行动本身正在付出什么”进行正式判断的机制。

它与 NAV-04｜Time 和 NAV-05｜Inaction 不同。

NAV-04 处理的是：

```
时间怎样改变决定
```

NAV-05 处理的是：

```
不采取新动作时，当前路径会怎样继续
```

而 NAV-18 进一步问：

> **当“继续等”已经成为一个主动选择时，这段等待本身正在消耗什么，而这些消耗是否已经大到足以改变 Wait / Act 的相对资格？**

例如：

```
等待 3 个月
```

可能带来：

```
more information
more savings
more recovery
better coordination
```

这时等待具有现实价值。

但相同的三个月也可能意味着：

```
cash burn continues
application window closes
skills become less current
relationship strain continues
health capacity declines
alternative options disappear
```

因此：

> **NAV-18 不反对等待；它只是拒绝把等待当成零成本背景。**

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
很多决定之所以长期停滞，不是因为用户真的选择了等待，而是因为系统没有要求等待回答：

```
What are we gaining?
What are we losing?
What becomes harder later?
What becomes easier later?
```

结果就是：

```
ACT
```

需要证明，

但：

```
WAIT
```

不需要证明。

NAV-18 必须取消这种不对称。

正确逻辑应该是：

```
ACT
and
WAIT
```

都要接受现实检验。

因此 NAV-18 建立：

```
Current Decision Space
+
Time
+
Inaction Consequences
+
Closing / Opening Conditions
↓
Waiting Value
vs
Waiting Cost
↓
Wait Qualification
```

核心问题不是：

> “现在行动是不是最勇敢？”

而是：

> **“从现在开始继续等待，是否仍然比现在行动保留更多价值与现实空间？”**

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-18 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
currentPosition
timeAssessment
inactionAssessment
remainingChoiceSpace
currentDefaultPath
knownWaitingBenefits
knownWaitingCosts
knownTimeSensitiveOptions
```

```
waiting is safer
```

maintenanceCostState
crossDomainPropagationMap
structuralAlternativeState
professionalInput
externalCurrentEvidence
relationshipContext
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 等待是否增加现实准备；
- 等待是否继续耗损容量；
- 等待是否使选项关闭；
- 等待是否只是延后不可避免的决定；

而不是：

NAV-18 可以：

例如：

```
monthly deficit = RM2,000
```

如果其他条件不变：

```
3 months waiting
≈ RM6,000 further depletion
```

必须明确：

```
assuming current deficit persists
```

---

## B. 判断等待是否真的会增加信息

例如：

```
formal interview result expected next week
```

则等待一周具有：

```

```

---

## C. 判断等待是否只是延后同一个问题

如果：

```
no new information
no resource gain
no capacity gain
no opening condition
```

则可以标记：

```
WAITING_VALUE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
```

---

## D. 识别等待是否让选项逐渐关闭

例如：

```

```

继续等待可能带来：

```

```

---

## E. 识别等待本身可以分阶段

例如：

```
WAIT 2 WEEKS FOR DATA
then
REASSESS
```

而不是：

```
WAIT INDEFINITELY
```

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-18 严禁：

## A. 把时间过去本身当作行动理由

禁止：

```
we have waited long enough
→ act
```

必须看等待到底改变了什么。

---

## B. 把行动焦虑包装成 Waiting Cost

```

```

可以进入用户体验，但不能自动建立现实成本。

---

## C. 把未来机会想象成确定损失

禁止：

```
if you wait you will miss a better job
```

除非有真实窗口或机会存在。

---

## D. 用 symbolic timing 建立现实紧迫性

禁止：

```

→ waiting cost high
```

---

## E. 因为等待有成本就自动推行动

```
waiting costs something
≠
acting costs less
```

两边必须比较。

---

## F. 把没有行动等同无准备

用户可能正在：

```
save
learn
negotiate
recover
collect evidence
```

这属于准备，不是纯等待。

OPTION_WEIGHT

REVIEW_TRIGGER

modules.decisionThresholdEffect:
等待成本上升并不会自动降低重大行动所需要的 Decision Sufficiency。

冻结：

```
HIGH WAITING COST
≠
LOW ACTION THRESHOLD
```

正确关系是：

```
Waiting Cost rises
→ Waiting loses default privilege
→ Alternative responses gain comparison priority
```

如果：

```
action = high impact + low reversibility
```

仍需要高门槛。

因此可能出现：

```
Waiting no longer qualified
+
Major action not yet qualified
```

此时最佳 Navigation 可能是：

```
PREPARE
LOCAL ADJUST
SMALL REVERSIBLE ACTION
PROFESSIONAL ESCALATION
```

而不是硬逼出一个二元答案。

NAV-18 可以：

- 识别等待价值；

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalTitleZh`
canonicalSections.body:
```
等待成本
```

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalTitleEn`
canonicalSections.body:
```
Waiting Cost
```

canonicalSections.heading: `canonicalQuestion`
canonicalSections.body:
```
当等待不再只是保留选择，而开始持续消耗现实条件时，
什么时候“再等等”本身就需要被重新证明？
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `definition`
canonicalSections.body:
**Waiting Cost** 是 Navigation 对“延迟决定或延迟行动本身正在付出什么”进行正式判断的机制。

它与 NAV-04｜Time 和 NAV-05｜Inaction 不同。

NAV-04 处理的是：

```
时间怎样改变决定
```

NAV-05 处理的是：

```
不采取新动作时，当前路径会怎样继续
```

而 NAV-18 进一步问：

> **当“继续等”已经成为一个主动选择时，这段等待本身正在消耗什么，而这些消耗是否已经大到足以改变 Wait / Act 的相对资格？**

例如：

```
等待 3 个月
```

可能带来：

```
more information
more savings
more recovery
better coordination
```

这时等待具有现实价值。

但相同的三个月也可能意味着：

```
cash burn continues
application window closes
skills become less current
relationship strain continues
health capacity declines
alternative options disappear
```

因此：

> **NAV-18 不反对等待；它只是拒绝把等待当成零成本背景。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `navigationMeaning`
canonicalSections.body:
很多决定之所以长期停滞，不是因为用户真的选择了等待，而是因为系统没有要求等待回答：

```
What are we gaining?
What are we losing?
What becomes harder later?
What becomes easier later?
```

结果就是：

```
ACT
```

需要证明，

但：

```
WAIT
```

不需要证明。

NAV-18 必须取消这种不对称。

正确逻辑应该是：

```
ACT
and
WAIT
```

都要接受现实检验。

因此 NAV-18 建立：

```
Current Decision Space
+
Time
+
Inaction Consequences
+
Closing / Opening Conditions
↓
Waiting Value
vs
Waiting Cost
↓
Wait Qualification
```

核心问题不是：

> “现在行动是不是最勇敢？”

而是：

> **“从现在开始继续等待，是否仍然比现在行动保留更多价值与现实空间？”**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Core Waiting States
canonicalSections.body:
建议 runtime 至少区分：

```
WAITING_QUALIFIED
WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW
WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING
WAITING_COST_RISING
WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT
WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED
WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN
```

---

## A. `WAITING_QUALIFIED`

等待正在带来真实价值，例如：

```
new evidence expected
cash buffer growing
recovery improving
permission pending
capability building
```

而成本仍可接受。

---

## B. `WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW`

等待仍然合理，但某些条件开始：

```
close
decay
accumulate cost
```

需要明确 review point。

---

## C. `WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING`

等待原本有价值，但继续多等带来的新增价值正在下降。

例如：

```
first month:
useful information arrives

next three months:
no new information expected
```

---

## D. `WAITING_COST_RISING`

等待开始持续增加：

```
financial cost
capacity cost
relationship cost
option loss
maintenance burden
```

---

## E. `WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT`

等待仍然是一个候选，但不能再因为：

```
“还没决定”
```

而自动成为默认路径。

---

## F. `WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED`

当前 evidence 已不足以支持继续等待作为主要路径。

这不等于：

```
ACT NOW
```

而是：

```
WAIT must be re-justified
or replaced by
PREPARE / MONITOR / ACT / ESCALATE
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting Cost Dimensions
canonicalSections.body:
建议至少检查：

```
FINANCIAL_WAITING_COST
OPTION_WAITING_COST
CAPACITY_WAITING_COST
RELATIONSHIP_WAITING_COST
INFORMATION_WAITING_COST
OPPORTUNITY_WAITING_COST
REVERSIBILITY_WAITING_COST
RESPONSIBILITY_WAITING_COST
```

---

## A. `FINANCIAL_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
monthly deficit continues
interest accumulates
reserve declines
```

---

## B. `OPTION_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
application closes
offer expires
role disappears
school window ends
```

---

## C. `CAPACITY_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
continued overload
continues to reduce usable bandwidth
```

但必须基于现实 observation。

---

## D. `RELATIONSHIP_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
unresolved issue
continues to increase coordination burden
```

不能推测他人隐藏心理。

---

## E. `INFORMATION_WAITING_COST`

有些时候等待不仅没有增加信息，反而让资料失效。

例如：

```
market quote becomes stale
offer terms change
current state moves
```

---

## F. `OPPORTUNITY_WAITING_COST`

等待可能让现实中的替代机会减少。

不能把假想收益当确定损失。

---

## G. `REVERSIBILITY_WAITING_COST`

继续等待可能让原本可逆的路径逐渐变得更难撤回。

例如：

```
more capital committed
more dependence created
more contract lock-in
```

---

canonicalSections.body:
Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
whatContinuesWhileWaiting
whatImprovesWhileWaiting
whatDecaysWhileWaiting
whatMayClose
whatNewInformationIsExpected
whatRemainsUnknown
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `runtimeConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-18 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Professional Handoff
Report Follow-up
```

消费。

尤其适用于：

```
“我是不是应该再等等？”
```

这类问题。

---

canonicalSections.heading: `academyConsumer`
canonicalSections.body:
Academy 可以投影为：

> **Waiting is valuable only while time is doing useful work for the decision.**

中文：

> **只有当时间正在为这个决定做有价值的工作时，等待才继续拥有资格。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: `revisionTriggers`
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况必须重开 NAV-18：

```
reviewDateReached
deadlineChanged
newInformationArrived
expectedInformationDelayed
financialRunwayChanged
optionClosed
newOptionOpened
capacityImproved
capacityDeclined
structuralAlternativeAppeared
userChangesWaitBoundary
professionalInput
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Waiting Model
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
{
  "waitingAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "waitingUntil": null,
  "waitingFor": [],
  "waitingValue": [],
  "waitingCosts": {
    "financial": [],
    "option": [],
    "capacity": [],
    "relationship": [],
    "information": [],
    "opportunity": [],
    "reversibility": [],
    "responsibility": []
  },
  "closingConditions": [],
  "openingConditions": [],
  "reviewTriggers": [],
  "state": "WAITING_QUALIFIED | WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW | WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING | WAITING_COST_RISING | WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT | WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED | WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN",
  "unknowns": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting-for-What Rule
canonicalSections.body:
任何 meaningful waiting 都应该尽量回答：

```
WAITING FOR WHAT?
```

例如：

```
waiting for:
job offer
medical result
cash buffer
school decision
contract clarification
recovery period
```

如果答案只是：

```
waiting for things to become clearer
```

系统应继续问：

```
what information would make it clearer?
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Review Boundary Rule
canonicalSections.body:
等待不能无限期缺乏边界。

可以通过：

```
DATE_TRIGGER
EVENT_TRIGGER
STATE_TRIGGER
```

结束。

例如：

```
DATE_TRIGGER:
30 days

EVENT_TRIGGER:
offer received

STATE_TRIGGER:
cash buffer reaches target
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Productive Waiting Rule
canonicalSections.body:
等待如果同时包含：

```
information gain
resource gain
capacity gain
recovery gain
coordination gain
```

可标记：

```
PRODUCTIVE_WAITING
```

它与：

```
PASSIVE_DELAY
```

必须区分。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Passive Delay Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
no defined gain
no review point
no trigger
no preparation
```

则可以标记：

```
PASSIVE_DELAY
```

但不能道德化成：

```
cowardice
avoidance
failure
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting Value Decay Rule
canonicalSections.body:
一种等待最初可能非常有价值。

例如：

```
wait for formal result
```

但一旦结果已经到达：

```
original waiting value = exhausted
```

如果继续等待，必须重新取得新理由。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting Cost Acceleration Rule
canonicalSections.body:
等待成本可能不是线性的。

例如：

```
first month:
small cost

after deadline:
large penalty
```

或：

```
early delay:
reversible

later delay:
lock-in increases
```

因此应支持：

```
WAITING_COST_ACCELERATION
```

而不能一律按固定 monthly cost 处理。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Wait-to-Act Crossover Rule
canonicalSections.body:
当：

```
additional waiting value
<
additional waiting cost
```

并且这个差异已经具有现实意义时，可以标记：

```
WAIT_TO_ACT_CROSSOVER
```

但这仍然只表示：

```
waiting loses relative advantage
```

不是：

```
execute biggest action now
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting vs Preparation Rule
canonicalSections.body:
冻结：

```
WAITING
≠
PREPARATION
```

例如：

```
不辞职 + 存钱 + 面试 + 学技能
```

不是纯等待。

应进入：

```
R2_PREPARE
```

以及相应 action path。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting vs Monitoring Rule
canonicalSections.body:
同样：

```
WAITING
≠
ACTIVE_MONITORING
```

如果已经定义：

```
signal
threshold
review time
```

则等待具有明确 observation function。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting vs Inaction Rule
canonicalSections.body:
NAV-05 与 NAV-18 分工：

```
NAV-05:
What happens if nothing new is done?

NAV-18:
Has continuing to defer the next decision itself become too costly?
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting vs Reversibility Rule
canonicalSections.body:
等待并不总是更可逆。

有时：

```
waiting
```

本身会造成：

```
loss of reversible window
```

例如：

```
early intervention possible
later intervention expensive
```

因此：

```
wait
≠
safe
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Waiting vs Authority Rule
canonicalSections.body:
如果：

```
professionalRequired
consentRequired
authorityUnknown
```

导致行动必须等待，

则这类等待不能被简单标成不合理。

它可能属于：

```
REQUIRED_WAITING
```

但仍需跟踪成本与期限。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Projection Example
canonicalSections.body:
内部：

```
Decision:
Whether to remain in current role

Waiting:
3 more months

Waiting value:
possible annual bonus
two active job applications may resolve

Waiting cost:
monthly recovery strain
internal transfer closes in 5 weeks
job-search time remains limited

State:
WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW
```

客户可以看到：

> **继续等一段时间仍然有价值，但这段等待已经不能没有边界。**
> 
> 接下来几周可能出现两项真正会改变判断的信息：年度奖金是否兑现，以及正在进行的两项工作申请是否有结果，因此立刻作出最大的决定并不一定更好；但同时，内部调岗窗口只剩五周，而现有工作负荷还在继续占用恢复与求职时间。
> 
> 所以目前更合理的并不是简单地“再等三个月”，而是把等待拆成一个有边界的阶段：先等到这些关键资料出现，同时保留调岗窗口；一旦原本期待的信息已经得到，等待本身就需要重新取得理由。

---

canonicalSections.heading: Customer Actions
canonicalSections.body:
允许：

```
Wait with boundary
Set review date
Set event trigger
Add expected information
Add waiting cost
Convert waiting to preparation
Choose smaller action
Reassess now
Continue
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: `status`
canonicalSections.body:
建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
WAITING_QUALIFIED
WAITING_WITH_REVIEW
WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING
WAITING_COST_RISING
WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT
WAITING_NOT_QUALIFIED
WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN
REOPENED
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Fail-Closed Conditions
canonicalSections.body:
以下情况不得进入 NAV-19：

```
waitingPurposeUnknown
waitingCostFabricated
deadlineInvented
opportunityLossPresentedAsCertainWithoutEvidence
symbolicTimingUsedAsUrgencyAuthority
expectedInformationUndefined
reviewBoundaryMissingForMaterialDelay
currentPositionStale
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Runtime Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Navigation must require waiting to justify itself whenever delay materially changes cost, option space, reversibility, capacity, or responsibility.**

中文：

> **只要延迟会实质改变成本、选择空间、可逆性、容量或责任，Navigation 就必须要求“等待”本身取得现实理由。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Value Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **Waiting remains qualified while time is expected to add information, capacity, recovery, coordination, or option value that outweighs the material cost of delay.**

中文：

> **只有当时间预计能够增加信息、容量、恢复、协调或选择价值，并且这些增益足以覆盖延迟的现实成本时，等待才继续拥有资格。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Default-Loss Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **When waiting stops creating meaningful new decision conditions and begins mainly consuming existing ones, it loses automatic default status.**

中文：

> **当等待不再产生新的有效决策条件，而主要开始消耗既有条件时，它就失去自动成为默认路径的资格。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Threshold Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **A rising cost of waiting does not automatically qualify a large irreversible action; it first removes waiting’s privilege and reopens comparison among available responses.**

中文：

> **等待成本上升，并不会自动让一个巨大且不可逆的行动取得资格；它首先做的是取消等待的默认特权，并重新打开不同回应之间的比较。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Canonical Bounded-Wait Rule
canonicalSections.body:
> **A bounded wait has a reason, a review point, and a condition that can end the wait.**

中文：

> **有边界的等待必须知道自己为什么等、什么时候复核，以及什么条件出现以后就不再继续等。**

---

canonicalSections.heading: Final Canonical Form
canonicalSections.body:
```
NAV-18
WAITING COST
```

**Input**

```
Current Decision Space
+
Waiting Path
+
Expected Waiting Value
+
Waiting Costs
+
Time-Sensitive Conditions
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
What are we waiting for?
What will time add?
What will time consume?
What may close?
When does waiting lose its advantage?
```

**Output**

```
Waiting Qualification State
+
Review / Trigger Boundary
```

**Boundary**

```
Waiting is not free.
Waiting is not automatically wrong.
Urgency does not automatically justify the largest action.
```

modules.canonicalText:
# NAV-18｜Waiting Cost

## 等待成本｜什么时候等待已经比行动更昂贵

**Canonical Question｜规范问题**

> **当等待不再只是保留选择，而开始持续消耗现实条件时，什么时候“再等等”本身就需要被重新证明？**

---

## 1. `moduleId`

```
NAV-18
```

## 2. `canonicalTitleZh`

```
等待成本
```

## 3. `canonicalTitleEn`

```
Waiting Cost
```

## 4. `canonicalQuestion`

```
当等待不再只是保留选择，而开始持续消耗现实条件时，
什么时候“再等等”本身就需要被重新证明？
```

---

# 5. `definition`

**Waiting Cost** 是 Navigation 对“延迟决定或延迟行动本身正在付出什么”进行正式判断的机制。

它与 NAV-04｜Time 和 NAV-05｜Inaction 不同。

NAV-04 处理的是：

```
时间怎样改变决定
```

NAV-05 处理的是：

```
不采取新动作时，当前路径会怎样继续
```

而 NAV-18 进一步问：

> **当“继续等”已经成为一个主动选择时，这段等待本身正在消耗什么，而这些消耗是否已经大到足以改变 Wait / Act 的相对资格？**

例如：

```
等待 3 个月
```

可能带来：

```
more information
more savings
more recovery
better coordination
```

这时等待具有现实价值。

但相同的三个月也可能意味着：

```
cash burn continues
application window closes
skills become less current
relationship strain continues
health capacity declines
alternative options disappear
```

因此：

> **NAV-18 不反对等待；它只是拒绝把等待当成零成本背景。**

---

# 6. `navigationMeaning`

很多决定之所以长期停滞，不是因为用户真的选择了等待，而是因为系统没有要求等待回答：

```
What are we gaining?
What are we losing?
What becomes harder later?
What becomes easier later?
```

结果就是：

```
ACT
```

需要证明，

但：

```
WAIT
```

不需要证明。

NAV-18 必须取消这种不对称。

正确逻辑应该是：

```
ACT
and
WAIT
```

都要接受现实检验。

因此 NAV-18 建立：

```
Current Decision Space
+
Time
+
Inaction Consequences
+
Closing / Opening Conditions
↓
Waiting Value
vs
Waiting Cost
↓
Wait Qualification
```

核心问题不是：

> “现在行动是不是最勇敢？”

而是：

> **“从现在开始继续等待，是否仍然比现在行动保留更多价值与现实空间？”**

---

# 7. `requiredInputs`

NAV-18 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
currentPosition
timeAssessment
inactionAssessment
remainingChoiceSpace
currentDefaultPath
knownWaitingBenefits
knownWaitingCosts
knownTimeSensitiveOptions
```

如果无法确认等待正在带来什么或消耗什么，应保持：

```
WAITING_VALUE_UNKNOWN
WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN
```

而不是自动假设：

```
waiting is safer
```

---

# 8. `optionalInputs`

```
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
capacityQualificationState
maintenanceCostState
crossDomainPropagationMap
structuralAlternativeState
professionalInput
externalCurrentEvidence
relationshipContext
priorNavigationState
```

这些用于判断：

- 等待是否增加现实准备；
- 等待是否继续耗损容量；
- 等待是否使选项关闭；
- 等待是否只是延后不可避免的决定；
- 是否存在更可逆的中间行动。

---

# 9. `inputAuthorityClasses`

允许：

```
USER_REPORTED
DIRECTLY_OBSERVED
VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_DATA
FINANCIAL_RECORD
CONTRACTUAL_RECORD
CURRENT_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
PROFILE_EVIDENCE
REPORT_INTERPRETATION
SYMBOLIC_READING
PRIOR_NAVIGATION_STATE
```

但现实 Waiting Cost 应主要来自：

```
MATERIAL_TIME_EFFECT
OBSERVED_RESOURCE_CHANGE
VERIFIED_WINDOW_CHANGE
OBSERVED_CAPACITY_CHANGE
```

而不是：

```
INTERPRETIVE_URGENCY
```

---

# 10. Core Waiting States

建议 runtime 至少区分：

```
WAITING_QUALIFIED
WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW
WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING
WAITING_COST_RISING
WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT
WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED
WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN
```

---

## A. `WAITING_QUALIFIED`

等待正在带来真实价值，例如：

```
new evidence expected
cash buffer growing
recovery improving
permission pending
capability building
```

而成本仍可接受。

---

## B. `WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW`

等待仍然合理，但某些条件开始：

```
close
decay
accumulate cost
```

需要明确 review point。

---

## C. `WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING`

等待原本有价值，但继续多等带来的新增价值正在下降。

例如：

```
first month:
useful information arrives

next three months:
no new information expected
```

---

## D. `WAITING_COST_RISING`

等待开始持续增加：

```
financial cost
capacity cost
relationship cost
option loss
maintenance burden
```

---

## E. `WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT`

等待仍然是一个候选，但不能再因为：

```
“还没决定”
```

而自动成为默认路径。

---

## F. `WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED`

当前 evidence 已不足以支持继续等待作为主要路径。

这不等于：

```
ACT NOW
```

而是：

```
WAIT must be re-justified
or replaced by
PREPARE / MONITOR / ACT / ESCALATE
```

---

# 11. Waiting Cost Dimensions

建议至少检查：

```
FINANCIAL_WAITING_COST
OPTION_WAITING_COST
CAPACITY_WAITING_COST
RELATIONSHIP_WAITING_COST
INFORMATION_WAITING_COST
OPPORTUNITY_WAITING_COST
REVERSIBILITY_WAITING_COST
RESPONSIBILITY_WAITING_COST
```

---

## A. `FINANCIAL_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
monthly deficit continues
interest accumulates
reserve declines
```

---

## B. `OPTION_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
application closes
offer expires
role disappears
school window ends
```

---

## C. `CAPACITY_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
continued overload
continues to reduce usable bandwidth
```

但必须基于现实 observation。

---

## D. `RELATIONSHIP_WAITING_COST`

例如：

```
unresolved issue
continues to increase coordination burden
```

不能推测他人隐藏心理。

---

## E. `INFORMATION_WAITING_COST`

有些时候等待不仅没有增加信息，反而让资料失效。

例如：

```
market quote becomes stale
offer terms change
current state moves
```

---

## F. `OPPORTUNITY_WAITING_COST`

等待可能让现实中的替代机会减少。

不能把假想收益当确定损失。

---

## G. `REVERSIBILITY_WAITING_COST`

继续等待可能让原本可逆的路径逐渐变得更难撤回。

例如：

```
more capital committed
more dependence created
more contract lock-in
```

---

# 12. `allowedInference`

NAV-18 可以：

## A. 比较等待期间发生的资源变化

例如：

```
monthly deficit = RM2,000
```

如果其他条件不变：

```
3 months waiting
≈ RM6,000 further depletion
```

必须明确：

```
assuming current deficit persists
```

---

## B. 判断等待是否真的会增加信息

例如：

```
formal interview result expected next week
```

则等待一周具有：

```
INFORMATION_GAIN
```

---

## C. 判断等待是否只是延后同一个问题

如果：

```
no new information
no resource gain
no capacity gain
no opening condition
```

则可以标记：

```
WAITING_VALUE_NOT_ESTABLISHED
```

---

## D. 识别等待是否让选项逐渐关闭

例如：

```
internal transfer deadline in 2 weeks
```

继续等待可能带来：

```
OPTION_WAITING_COST
```

---

## E. 识别等待本身可以分阶段

例如：

```
WAIT 2 WEEKS FOR DATA
then
REASSESS
```

而不是：

```
WAIT INDEFINITELY
```

---

# 13. `forbiddenInference`

NAV-18 严禁：

## A. 把时间过去本身当作行动理由

禁止：

```
we have waited long enough
→ act
```

必须看等待到底改变了什么。

---

## B. 把行动焦虑包装成 Waiting Cost

```
I hate waiting
```

可以进入用户体验，但不能自动建立现实成本。

---

## C. 把未来机会想象成确定损失

禁止：

```
if you wait you will miss a better job
```

除非有真实窗口或机会存在。

---

## D. 用 symbolic timing 建立现实紧迫性

禁止：

```
Tarot says now
→ waiting cost high
```

---

## E. 因为等待有成本就自动推行动

```
waiting costs something
≠
acting costs less
```

两边必须比较。

---

## F. 把没有行动等同无准备

用户可能正在：

```
save
learn
negotiate
recover
collect evidence
```

这属于准备，不是纯等待。

---

# 14. `decisionEffect`

NAV-18 主要影响：

```
WAIT_ACT_BALANCE
OPTION_WEIGHT
ACTION_TIMING
REVIEW_TRIGGER
ACTION_SCALE
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_PRIORITY
```

核心 effect：

```
WAIT_QUALIFICATION
```

---

# 15. `decisionThresholdEffect`

等待成本上升并不会自动降低重大行动所需要的 Decision Sufficiency。

冻结：

```
HIGH WAITING COST
≠
LOW ACTION THRESHOLD
```

正确关系是：

```
Waiting Cost rises
→ Waiting loses default privilege
→ Alternative responses gain comparison priority
```

如果：

```
action = high impact + low reversibility
```

仍需要高门槛。

因此可能出现：

```
Waiting no longer qualified
+
Major action not yet qualified
```

此时最佳 Navigation 可能是：

```
PREPARE
LOCAL ADJUST
SMALL REVERSIBLE ACTION
PROFESSIONAL ESCALATION
```

而不是硬逼出一个二元答案。

---

# 16. `authorityBoundary`

NAV-18 可以：

- 计算等待成本；
- 识别等待价值；
- 识别 option decay；
- 识别等待失去默认资格；
- 设定 review point；
- 让较小行动进入比较。

NAV-18 不可以：

- 因等待昂贵而自动要求行动；
- 制造人为 deadline；
- 使用 Method Reading 制造紧迫性；
- 把机会成本伪装成确定损失；
- 将情绪焦虑当现实 deadline。

---

# 17. `humanDecisionBoundary`

即使：

```
WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT
```

用户仍然可以选择等待。

但应变成：

```
CONSCIOUS_WAITING
```

也就是：

> 我知道等待每个月正在消耗什么，也知道什么条件可能关闭，但我仍然决定等待到某个明确节点。

这与：

```
INDEFINITE_DEFERRAL
```

不同。

---

# 18. `sourceSections`

主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.20｜什么时候等待已经比行动更昂贵
```

相关：

```
15.6｜时间已经进入决定
15.7｜不行动也正在产生后果
15.8｜能不能回头，会改变决定本身
15.12｜回应可以有不同等级
15.18｜什么时候更多投入已经不再合理
15.19｜修正参数，还是把重构放进候选
```

---

# 19. `relatedBookFoundations`

## Book III｜Reality Continuity

提供：

```
accumulation
maintenance burden
continued cost
```

NAV-18 不重新解释成本为什么累积。

只问：

> **如果等待让这些成本继续累积，这是否已经改变 Wait 的现实资格？**

---

## Book VII｜Reality Observation

提供：

```
currentness
evidence freshness
unknown
```

支持：

```
waiting may improve evidence
or
waiting may make evidence stale
```

---

# 20. `profileConsumer`

Profile 可以提供：

```
delay preference
urgency preference
uncertainty tolerance
action tendency
```

但只能作为：

```
BEHAVIORAL_CONTEXT
```

不能决定：

```
WAITING_COST
```

或：

```
ACT_NOW
```

---

# 21. `financialConsumer`

Financial 是 NAV-18 的强输入。

可提供：

```
monthly burn
liquidity decay
interest accumulation
payment dates
runway
```

例如：

```
RM60,000 usable liquidity
RM10,000 monthly deficit
```

可以形成：

```
~6 months current runway
```

但必须保留假设与 currentness。

---

# 22. `methodConsumer`

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR：

只能提供：

```
INTERPRETIVE_TIMING_CONTEXT
```

不得建立：

```
REAL_WAITING_COST
FIXED_DEADLINE
ACT_NOW
```

---

# 23. `currentRealityConsumer`

Current Reality 至少应提供：

```
whatContinuesWhileWaiting
whatImprovesWhileWaiting
whatDecaysWhileWaiting
whatMayClose
whatNewInformationIsExpected
whatRemainsUnknown
```

---

# 24. `runtimeConsumer`

NAV-18 可被：

```
My Reality Navigation
Career Navigation
Financial Navigation
Relationship Navigation
Estate Navigation
Professional Handoff
Report Follow-up
```

消费。

尤其适用于：

```
“我是不是应该再等等？”
```

这类问题。

---

# 25. `academyConsumer`

Academy 可以投影为：

> **Waiting is valuable only while time is doing useful work for the decision.**

中文：

> **只有当时间正在为这个决定做有价值的工作时，等待才继续拥有资格。**

---

# 26. `revisionTriggers`

以下情况必须重开 NAV-18：

```
reviewDateReached
deadlineChanged
newInformationArrived
expectedInformationDelayed
financialRunwayChanged
optionClosed
newOptionOpened
capacityImproved
capacityDeclined
structuralAlternativeAppeared
userChangesWaitBoundary
professionalInput
```

---

# 27. Canonical Waiting Model

建议：

```
{
  "waitingAssessmentId": "",
  "decisionObjectId": "",
  "waitingUntil": null,
  "waitingFor": [],
  "waitingValue": [],
  "waitingCosts": {
    "financial": [],
    "option": [],
    "capacity": [],
    "relationship": [],
    "information": [],
    "opportunity": [],
    "reversibility": [],
    "responsibility": []
  },
  "closingConditions": [],
  "openingConditions": [],
  "reviewTriggers": [],
  "state": "WAITING_QUALIFIED | WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW | WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING | WAITING_COST_RISING | WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT | WAITING_NOT_CURRENTLY_QUALIFIED | WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN",
  "unknowns": [],
  "sources": [],
  "status": ""
}
```

---

# 28. Waiting-for-What Rule

任何 meaningful waiting 都应该尽量回答：

```
WAITING FOR WHAT?
```

例如：

```
waiting for:
job offer
medical result
cash buffer
school decision
contract clarification
recovery period
```

如果答案只是：

```
waiting for things to become clearer
```

系统应继续问：

```
what information would make it clearer?
```

---

# 29. Review Boundary Rule

等待不能无限期缺乏边界。

可以通过：

```
DATE_TRIGGER
EVENT_TRIGGER
STATE_TRIGGER
```

结束。

例如：

```
DATE_TRIGGER:
30 days

EVENT_TRIGGER:
offer received

STATE_TRIGGER:
cash buffer reaches target
```

---

# 30. Productive Waiting Rule

等待如果同时包含：

```
information gain
resource gain
capacity gain
recovery gain
coordination gain
```

可标记：

```
PRODUCTIVE_WAITING
```

它与：

```
PASSIVE_DELAY
```

必须区分。

---

# 31. Passive Delay Rule

如果：

```
no defined gain
no review point
no trigger
no preparation
```

则可以标记：

```
PASSIVE_DELAY
```

但不能道德化成：

```
cowardice
avoidance
failure
```

---

# 32. Waiting Value Decay Rule

一种等待最初可能非常有价值。

例如：

```
wait for formal result
```

但一旦结果已经到达：

```
original waiting value = exhausted
```

如果继续等待，必须重新取得新理由。

---

# 33. Waiting Cost Acceleration Rule

等待成本可能不是线性的。

例如：

```
first month:
small cost

after deadline:
large penalty
```

或：

```
early delay:
reversible

later delay:
lock-in increases
```

因此应支持：

```
WAITING_COST_ACCELERATION
```

而不能一律按固定 monthly cost 处理。

---

# 34. Wait-to-Act Crossover Rule

当：

```
additional waiting value
<
additional waiting cost
```

并且这个差异已经具有现实意义时，可以标记：

```
WAIT_TO_ACT_CROSSOVER
```

但这仍然只表示：

```
waiting loses relative advantage
```

不是：

```
execute biggest action now
```

---

# 35. Waiting vs Preparation Rule

冻结：

```
WAITING
≠
PREPARATION
```

例如：

```
不辞职 + 存钱 + 面试 + 学技能
```

不是纯等待。

应进入：

```
R2_PREPARE
```

以及相应 action path。

---

# 36. Waiting vs Monitoring Rule

同样：

```
WAITING
≠
ACTIVE_MONITORING
```

如果已经定义：

```
signal
threshold
review time
```

则等待具有明确 observation function。

---

# 37. Waiting vs Inaction Rule

NAV-05 与 NAV-18 分工：

```
NAV-05:
What happens if nothing new is done?

NAV-18:
Has continuing to defer the next decision itself become too costly?
```

---

# 38. Waiting vs Reversibility Rule

等待并不总是更可逆。

有时：

```
waiting
```

本身会造成：

```
loss of reversible window
```

例如：

```
early intervention possible
later intervention expensive
```

因此：

```
wait
≠
safe
```

---

# 39. Waiting vs Authority Rule

如果：

```
professionalRequired
consentRequired
authorityUnknown
```

导致行动必须等待，

则这类等待不能被简单标成不合理。

它可能属于：

```
REQUIRED_WAITING
```

但仍需跟踪成本与期限。

---

# 40. Customer Projection Example

内部：

```
Decision:
Whether to remain in current role

Waiting:
3 more months

Waiting value:
possible annual bonus
two active job applications may resolve

Waiting cost:
monthly recovery strain
internal transfer closes in 5 weeks
job-search time remains limited

State:
WAITING_QUALIFIED_WITH_REVIEW
```

客户可以看到：

> **继续等一段时间仍然有价值，但这段等待已经不能没有边界。**
> 
> 接下来几周可能出现两项真正会改变判断的信息：年度奖金是否兑现，以及正在进行的两项工作申请是否有结果，因此立刻作出最大的决定并不一定更好；但同时，内部调岗窗口只剩五周，而现有工作负荷还在继续占用恢复与求职时间。
> 
> 所以目前更合理的并不是简单地“再等三个月”，而是把等待拆成一个有边界的阶段：先等到这些关键资料出现，同时保留调岗窗口；一旦原本期待的信息已经得到，等待本身就需要重新取得理由。

---

# 41. Customer Actions

允许：

```
Wait with boundary
Set review date
Set event trigger
Add expected information
Add waiting cost
Convert waiting to preparation
Choose smaller action
Reassess now
Continue
```

---

# 42. `status`

建议：

```
UNFORMED
PARTIAL
WAITING_QUALIFIED
WAITING_WITH_REVIEW
WAITING_VALUE_DECLINING
WAITING_COST_RISING
WAITING_NO_LONGER_DEFAULT
WAITING_NOT_QUALIFIED
WAITING_COST_UNKNOWN
REOPENED
```

---

# 43. Fail-Closed Conditions

以下情况不得进入 NAV-19：

```
waitingPurposeUnknown
waitingCostFabricated
deadlineInvented
opportunityLossPresentedAsCertainWithoutEvidence
symbolicTimingUsedAsUrgencyAuthority
expectedInformationUndefined
reviewBoundaryMissingForMaterialDelay
currentPositionStale
decisionObjectChanged
```

---

# 44. Canonical Runtime Rule

> **Navigation must require waiting to justify itself whenever delay materially changes cost, option space, reversibility, capacity, or responsibility.**

中文：

> **只要延迟会实质改变成本、选择空间、可逆性、容量或责任，Navigation 就必须要求“等待”本身取得现实理由。**

---

# 45. Canonical Value Rule

> **Waiting remains qualified while time is expected to add information, capacity, recovery, coordination, or option value that outweighs the material cost of delay.**

中文：

> **只有当时间预计能够增加信息、容量、恢复、协调或选择价值，并且这些增益足以覆盖延迟的现实成本时，等待才继续拥有资格。**

---

# 46. Canonical Default-Loss Rule

> **When waiting stops creating meaningful new decision conditions and begins mainly consuming existing ones, it loses automatic default status.**

中文：

> **当等待不再产生新的有效决策条件，而主要开始消耗既有条件时，它就失去自动成为默认路径的资格。**

---

# 47. Canonical Threshold Rule

> **A rising cost of waiting does not automatically qualify a large irreversible action; it first removes waiting’s privilege and reopens comparison among available responses.**

中文：

> **等待成本上升，并不会自动让一个巨大且不可逆的行动取得资格；它首先做的是取消等待的默认特权，并重新打开不同回应之间的比较。**

---

# 48. Canonical Bounded-Wait Rule

> **A bounded wait has a reason, a review point, and a condition that can end the wait.**

中文：

> **有边界的等待必须知道自己为什么等、什么时候复核，以及什么条件出现以后就不再继续等。**

---

# 49. Final Canonical Form

```
NAV-18
WAITING COST
```

**Input**

```
Current Decision Space
+
Waiting Path
+
Expected Waiting Value
+
Waiting Costs
+
Time-Sensitive Conditions
```

**Process**

```
Ask:
What are we waiting for?
What will time add?
What will time consume?
What may close?
When does waiting lose its advantage?
```

**Output**

```
Waiting Qualification State
+
Review / Trigger Boundary
```

**Boundary**

```
Waiting is not free.
Waiting is not automatically wrong.
Urgency does not automatically justify the largest action.
```

modules.canonicalQuestion:
当我们准备改变方向、结构或行动方式时，
怎样区分“必须改变的部分”与“其实仍然值得被保留下来的价值”？
modules.definition:
**Value Preservation** 是 Navigation 在结构改变、方向调整或重大行动进入比较以前，对“哪些价值、条件、能力、关系、责任或现实成果不应该因为改变本身而被无意摧毁”进行正式识别的机制。

它不回答：

> “什么是人生最重要的价值？”

也不是要求用户建立一套抽象价值观排名。

它真正处理的是：

> **如果当前路径需要改变，我们究竟是在改变什么，又有哪些原本由旧结构承载的东西，其实仍然值得继续被保护？**

例如，一个人可能想：

```
离开当前工作
```

但真正不想失去的可能包括：

```
稳定收入
医疗保障
专业身份
团队关系
某些技能积累
家庭时间可预测性
```

因此：

```
LEAVE JOB
```

并不必然意味着：

```
ABANDON EVERYTHING THE JOB CURRENTLY PROVIDES
```

同样，一个家庭想搬家，可能想改变：

```
通勤
住房成本
生活环境
```

但希望保留：

```
孩子教育连续性
家庭支持网络
财务缓冲
照护关系
```

因此：

> **NAV-19 的核心不是阻止改变，而是防止“为了离开一个有问题的结构，把结构里仍有价值的部分一起丢掉”。**

---
modules.navigationMeaning:
当 Default Direction 已经失去资格，Structural Alternative 已经进入候选以后，很容易出现另一种偏差：

```
old structure has problems
→ everything associated with old structure becomes suspect
```

这会造成：

```
necessary change
+
unnecessary loss
```

Navigation 必须把两者拆开。

因此 NAV-19 建立：

```
Current Structure
↓
What Is No Longer Working
↓
What Still Produces Value
↓
What Must Not Be Accidentally Destroyed
↓
Preservation Requirements
```

其真正目的不是保守，而是：

> **让改变更精确。**

---
modules.requiredInputs:
NAV-19 最低需要：

```
confirmedDecisionObject
currentPosition
currentDirectionState
structuralAlternativeState
currentValueProduced
knownResponsibilities
knownCriticalConditions
```

最好还包括：

```
maintenanceCostState
timeHorizonMap
reversibilityProfile
crossDomainPropagationMap
```

如果系统不知道当前路径到底还在提供什么，应保留：

```
PRESERVATION_VALUE_UNKNOWN
```

---
modules.optionalInputs:
```
profileNavigationProjection
financialNavigationProjection
currentRealityProjection
relationshipContext
careerContext
professionalInput
estateContext
careContext
priorNavigationState
userStatedValues
```

这些用于帮助识别：

- 哪些价值只是习惯；
- 哪些价值是现实依赖；
- 哪些是责任；
- 哪些可以换一种方式继续存在。

---
modules.inputAuthorityClasses:
允许：

```
USER_REPORTED
DIRECTLY_OBSERVED
VERIFIED_ACCOUNT_DATA
FINANCIAL_RECORD
PROFESSIONAL_INPUT
CURRENT_EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE
PROFILE_EVIDENCE
REPORT_INTERPRETATION
SYMBOLIC_READING
PRIOR_NAVIGATION_STATE
```

但必须区分：

```
USER_STATED_VALUE
MATERIAL_DEPENDENCY
OBSERVED_BENEFIT
RESPONSIBILITY
INTERPRETIVE_VALUE_CONTEXT
UNKNOWN
```

Profile / Method 可以帮助用户看见可能重视的主题，但不能替用户声明：

```
THIS IS YOUR CORE VALUE
```

---
modules.allowedInference:
NAV-19 可以：

## A. 识别旧结构里仍然存在的现实价值

例如：

```
工作虽然高负荷
但仍提供稳定收入与保险
```

可以把：

```
income continuity
insurance continuity
```

标记为 preservation candidates。

---

## B. 区分价值与承载价值的结构

例如：

```
Value:
financial stability

Current carrier:
current employer
```

不能自动推导：

```
financial stability requires current employer
```

系统应问：

```
can the value move to another carrier?
```

---

## C. 识别一个替代方案可能无意摧毁其他重要条件

例如：

```
Move abroad
```

可能影响：

```
family support network
care access
school continuity
```

这些必须进入比较。

---

## D. 识别某些价值其实已经不再由旧结构提供

例如：

用户认为：

```
current job = growth
```

但现实显示：

```
no meaningful learning for 3 years
```

则：

```
growth
```

不能继续自动记在旧结构的 preservation column。

---

## E. 识别某个价值可以通过别的方式保留

例如：

```
current job provides identity
```

但如果身份来自专业领域，而不是公司本身，则可能属于：

```
TRANSFERABLE_VALUE
```

---
modules.forbiddenInference:
NAV-19 严禁：

## A. 替用户定义人生最高价值

禁止：

```
family must matter more than career
```

或反过来。

---

## B. 把用户过去重视的东西永久化

```
you valued status before
→ status must remain important
```

不允许。

---

## C. 把 Profile 直接当成价值声明

禁止：

```
Profile shows autonomy
→ autonomy = MUST_PRESERVE
```

必须由用户或现实责任确认。

---

## D. 把旧结构与价值绑定

禁止：

```
leaving job
=
losing professional identity
```

除非确实 structure-bound。

---

## E. 把所有损失都视为不可接受

改变一定可能带来损失。

NAV-19 不是：

```
LOSS ELIMINATION
```

而是：

```
UNINTENDED VALUE LOSS PREVENTION
```

---

## F. 用 symbolic reading 声称某价值是“命中注定”

禁止。

---
modules.decisionEffect:
NAV-19 主要影响：

```
OPTION_ELIGIBILITY
OPTION_WEIGHT
STRUCTURAL_ALTERNATIVE_DESIGN
TRANSITION_REQUIREMENT
ACTION_SCALE
DECISION_THRESHOLD
```

核心 effect：

```
PRESERVATION_REQUIREMENT
```

也就是：

> **候选方案除了回答“要改变什么”，也必须回答“准备保留什么”。**

---
modules.decisionThresholdEffect:
如果一个方案会影响：

```
MUST_PRESERVE
```

条件，则需要更高：

```
evidence
transition planning
reversibility review
professional input where relevant
```

冻结原则：

> **The more a decision threatens values or conditions that must be preserved, the stronger the transition proof required before execution.**

中文：

> **一个决定越可能伤及必须保留的价值或条件，真正执行以前所需要的转换证明就越强。**

---
modules.authorityBoundary:
NAV-19 可以：

- 暴露值得保留的价值；
- 区分 value / carrier；
- 识别 unintended loss；
- 为 alternative 增加 preservation requirement；
- 识别价值是否可迁移；
- 触发更谨慎 transition design。

NAV-19 不可以：

- 替用户制定价值层级；
- 用 Profile 或 Method 替用户决定价值；
- 要求零损失改变；
- 因为某价值存在就否决所有改变；
- 把过去依恋伪装成必须保留。

---
modules.humanDecisionBoundary:
价值判断最终必须回到用户。

系统可以说：

> 目前这份工作仍然提供稳定收入、医疗保障和专业身份；如果你想改变工作结构，需要确认这三项里哪些是你真正必须保留的，哪些可以通过其他方式重新建立。

但系统不能说：

> 稳定收入一定比职业自由重要。

用户应能够将每项标记为：

```
MUST_PRESERVE
PREFER_TO_PRESERVE
NOT_REQUIRED
UNSURE
```

---
modules.sourceSections:
主要来源：

```
Book VIII
15.21｜改变以前，先确认什么不能被无意失去
```

相关：

```

15.23｜价值什么时候彼此冲突

15.26｜哪些损失可以交换，哪些不能

```

what allows reality to continue
```

## Book IV｜Reality Expansion

capacity expansion

modules.profileConsumer:
Profile 可以帮助生成：

```
VALUE_CHECK_CANDIDATES
```

例如：

```
autonomy
stability

meaning
mastery
```

MUST_PRESERVE

MATERIAL_MUST_PRESERVE
```

AST / BAZI / ZIWEI / NUM / HD / ECR：

```
INTERPRETIVE_VALUE_CONTEXT
```

例如某些反复主题。

但不得直接：

```
